What does the Second Amendment actually say?
a

It reads: "A well regulated Militia, being necessary to the security of a free State, the right of the people to keep and bear Arms, shall not be infringed." It was ratified in 1791 as part of the Bill of Rights.

What does the First Amendment say?
a

It says Congress shall make no law establishing a religion or stopping people practising theirs, and none limiting freedom of speech, freedom of the press, the right to gather peacefully, or the right to petition the government.

How does the Japanese constitution describe the Emperor's role?
a
Article 1 says the Emperor is the symbol of the State and of the unity of the people, and that his position comes from the will of the people, with whom sovereign power resides.

What does Article 5 of the NATO treaty say?
a

Article 5 says an armed attack on one member is considered an attack on all, and that each member will help by taking the action it considers necessary, including armed force. It has been used once, after the attacks of 11 September 2001.

What does Article 50 of the EU treaty say?
a

Article 50 says any member state may decide to leave the EU. It tells the European Council, and the two sides then have two years to agree the terms of leaving, unless everyone agrees to extend that time.

What does the Fourteenth Amendment say about equal treatment?
a

Its first section says everyone born or naturalised in the United States is a citizen, and that no state may take away life, liberty or property without due process of law, or deny anyone the equal protection of the laws.

How can Japan's constitution be changed? What does it say?
a
Article 96 says an amendment must be proposed by the Diet with at least two thirds of all the members of each house in favour, and then approved by a majority of votes in a national referendum.

Who fired first in the Six-Day War?
a

Israel did: on 5 June 1967 it launched air strikes that destroyed most of Egypt's air force on the ground. That followed weeks of rising tension, in which Egypt moved troops into Sinai, had UN peacekeepers withdrawn and closed the Straits of Tiran to Israeli shipping. Israel describes its strike as pre-emptive.
